finding: When a planning card needs a metadata-only validator correction under an active same-lane claim, `tasks import --dry-run` computes the new planning source seal but `tasks import --write` would skip the active claim unless a broad force-overwrite route is used.
expectedBehavior: ATM should provide a governed same-owner metadata repair/import lane that updates validators and planning source seal while preserving the active claim, lease, lane session, and evidence continuity.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0245 replaced `validate:standard` with `node atm.mjs broker replay final-verdict --json`; dry-run produced content digest `sha256:da08e676...` but warned `IMPORT_SKIPPED_ACTIVE_CLAIM`, requiring a minimal emergency seal metadata repair to avoid claim displacement.
followUp: Add `tasks import --metadata-only --preserve-active-claim` or equivalent, with diff-limited validation and source-seal update receipts.
